description: Source file implementing classes and functions for handling internal DNS host resolver results, including serialization/deserialization, and various result types such as data, metadata, error, and alias.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult

classes.description: Derived class representing DNS results with associated metadata.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Derived class representing error results with an error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
